sections.description: As a new user, I want to register an account with email verification so that I can access the platform securely.
sections.business_value: Ensures valid user accounts and reduces spam registrations
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- User can fill registration form
- Verification email sent immediately
- User can click verification link
- Account activated upon verification
- Unverified accounts expire after 24 hours
sections.user_guide: Navigate to /register, complete the form, and check your email for the verification link.

sections.description: As a customer, I want to add items to my shopping cart and manage quantities so that I can review my purchases before checkout.
sections.business_value: Core e-commerce functionality that enables purchasing
sections.preconditions: User is logged in, products are available in inventory
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Add items to cart
- Update item quantities
- Remove items from cart
- View cart total price
- Cart persists across sessions

sections.description: As a customer, I want to securely complete my purchase with payment processing so that I can receive my ordered items.
sections.business_value: Enables revenue generation through secure transactions
sections.preconditions: Payment gateway integrated, SSL certificates configured
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Select payment method
- Enter payment details securely
- Process payment via gateway
- Display order confirmation
- Send confirmation email
sections.user_guide: After reviewing your cart, click 'Checkout', enter shipping and payment information, then confirm your order.

sections.description: As a customer, I want to search for products and apply filters so that I can quickly find items I'm interested in purchasing.
sections.business_value: Improves user experience and reduces time to purchase
sections.preconditions: Product catalog populated, search index configured
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Search by product name or description
- Filter by category, price range, brand
- Sort results by relevance, price, rating
- Display search results count
- Paginate results for large sets
sections.user_guide: Use the search bar to find products, then apply filters from the sidebar to narrow your results.

sections.description: As a customer, I want to view my order history and track shipments so that I can monitor my purchases.
sections.business_value: Reduces customer service inquiries and improves satisfaction
sections.preconditions: User has placed at least one order
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Display list of past orders
- Show order details (items, total, date)
- Display shipment tracking number
- Show current shipment status
- Allow order cancellation before shipping
sections.user_guide: Access your order history from your account dashboard to view details and track shipments.

sections.description: As a customer, I want to read and write product reviews so that I can make informed purchasing decisions.
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Display average rating and review count
- Show individual reviews with ratings
- Allow verified purchasers to write reviews
- Enable helpful vote on reviews
- Moderate reviews for inappropriate content
sections.user_guide: View reviews on product pages, or write your own after purchasing by visiting your order history.

sections.description: As a customer, I want to save products to a wishlist so that I can purchase them later.
sections.business_value: Increases repeat visits and eventual conversions
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Add products to wishlist
- Remove items from wishlist
- View all wishlist items
- Move items from wishlist to cart
- Share wishlist with others
sections.user_guide: Click the heart icon on any product to add it to your wishlist, accessible from your account menu.

sections.description: As a customer, I want to receive email notifications for order updates so that I stay informed about my purchases.
sections.business_value: Keeps customers informed and reduces support inquiries
sections.preconditions: Email service configured, user has valid email
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Send order confirmation email
- Send shipping notification with tracking
- Send delivery confirmation
- Allow users to opt-in/opt-out
- Include order details in emails
sections.user_guide: Manage your email preferences in account settings to control which notifications you receive.

sections.description: As an admin, I want a dashboard to manage orders so that I can process fulfillment efficiently.
sections.business_value: Streamlines operations and reduces fulfillment errors
sections.preconditions: Admin role configured, authentication in place
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- View all orders in dashboard
- Filter by status, date, customer
- Update order status
- Print packing slips
- Export order data
sections.user_guide: Access the admin dashboard at /admin to view and manage all customer orders.

sections.description: As an admin, I want to manage product inventory so that stock levels are accurate and customers can't order unavailable items.
sections.business_value: Prevents overselling and improves operational efficiency
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Update stock quantities
- Set low-stock alerts
- Track inventory changes
- Display out-of-stock on product pages
- Reserve inventory during checkout
sections.user_guide: Manage inventory from the admin dashboard under the Inventory section.

sections.description: As an international customer, I want to view prices in my local currency so that I understand the cost in familiar terms.
sections.business_value: Expands market reach to international customers
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Detect user location automatically
- Allow manual currency selection
- Display prices in selected currency
- Convert cart total to selected currency
- Store currency preference
sections.user_guide: Select your preferred currency from the dropdown in the header.

sections.description: As a customer, I want to apply promotional coupons to my order so that I can receive discounts.
sections.business_value: Enables marketing campaigns and increases conversion rates
sections.acceptance_criteria:
- Enter coupon code at checkout
- Validate coupon (active, not expired, usage limits)
- Apply discount to order total
- Display applied discount
- Prevent coupon stacking if configured
sections.user_guide: Enter your coupon code in the designated field during checkout to apply your discount.
